facts.business: Premier Energies Limited is an integrated clean energy solutions company engaged in Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) contracts and manufacturing across the solar value chain.

capacity_or_capex.timeline: Repayment commences 12 months from scheduled commercial operations i.e. 30th October 2026; repayable in 32 quarterly instalments

key_risks: Revenue recognition for EPC contracts involving judgement in identification of contractual obligations and allocation of transaction price to performance obligations
facts.related_party_note: All transactions with related parties are on arm's length basis. None of the balances are secured. Includes capital expenditure payable to Transcon Ind Limited (₹5.56 million), loans from Brightstone Developers Private Limited (₹21.08 million as at March 31, 2025), travel advances, interest payable, other payables, and personal guarantees from promoters Surenderpal Singh Saluja (₹210.80 million) and Chiranjeev Singh Saluja (₹37,732.90 million) as at March 31, 2026.
